status: Preparation manifest; execute only after final core/provider/wheel/profile freeze and launch authorization.
substitution: Substitute complete argv elements, without shell evaluation. All paths are absolute. Unresolved placeholders reject execution.

variables.PIXI: Absolute path to the verified Pixi 0.83.0 executable.
variables.CHECKOUT: Assigned build checkout with its own locked dev environment; used only to prepare the task-owned pinned builder.
variables.OWNED: Fresh /dev/shm/artisan-modal-final-<unique> owned by the current user; no symlink, maximum6GiB.
variables.CORE_SOURCE: Exact frozen core source snapshot under OWNED/source/core; exclude all installed environments.
variables.PROVIDER_SOURCE: Exact frozen provider source snapshot under OWNED/source/provider.
variables.APPLICATION_SOURCE: Exact frozen qualification/application snapshot under OWNED/source/application.
variables.PROFILE: OWNED/profile; canonical pixi.toml, pixi.lock and ordinary wheels/ files.
variables.HARNESS: OWNED/harness; exact hashed qualification .py files, including final_apps.py/final_launch.py.
variables.INPUTS: OWNED/launch-inputs.json; frozen LaunchInputs descriptor generated after installation.
variables.BUILDER_PYTHON: Verified interpreter from the freshly prepared task-owned core Hatchling builder binding.

environment_rules: Keep credentials live in existing selected SDK configuration; do not copy home, print environment or put credential values in this manifest.
No PYTHONPATH source overlay, editable install, copied or borrowed installed prefix.

Build/install commands require the existing local subtree supervisor, a finite deadline, the same root/tmpfs guards and explicit closure before removing scratch. This manifest is not an arbitrary-command executor.
No automatic retry or next phase after an unexpected failure.

argv: import sys; from pathlib import Path; from artisan.execution.environments.native import _prepare_builder, native_platform; target = _prepare_builder(Path(sys.argv[1]), native_platform()); Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(target.model_dump_json(indent=2) + "\n")

freeze_gate: Record the fresh builder canonical manifest/lock, verified prefix inventory, Hatchling1.31.0 RECORD/payload and exact existing backend bridge SHA256; never install Hatchling into the assigned prefix or borrow another builder environment.

Review exact source diffs/inventories, all three ordinary wheel hashes, canonical manifest/lock, pinned builder/base/Pixi, controller executable/import paths, and every installed core/provider/application/SDK RECORD payload file.
Populate LaunchInputs files with all those local files plus the unchanged qualification harness; wheel paths must remain inside the canonical profile root.
Verify the exact source hash mapping before and after every individual phase. Preserve earlier receipts and prefixes; never update a measured image in place.
Use the installed controller interpreter directly for launch, so runtime cannot solve or install. Canonical worker startup/tool activation still uses the pinned Pixi run contract.

remote_limits.gpu: one A10G in GPU group only

completion: Actual core unit/shared closure, output collection, independently stopped exact Apps with zero tasks, tunnel/queue/server cleanup and unchanged source are separate assertions. SDK stop alone never upgrades UNKNOWN. Expected UNKNOWN groups retain scratch; any unexpected failure stops qualification.

canonical_manifest.state: Unresolved template; copy unchanged after wheel builds, then execute the explicit canonical-lock command. No lock or installed profile is claimed by this source checkpoint.
